name: Watch Captain Parker
summary: At Three Corners, Watch Captain Parker guards the road and travelers bound for Lakeshire. He patrols the junction and watches the gnoll packs gathering nearby, an early line of defense for those heading into town.

sections.title: On Guard at Three Corners
sections.body: At Three Corners, Watch Captain Parker watches the roads between Elwynn Forest, Duskwood, and Redridge. Stormwind has few troops to spare, and little official help reaches the region. Parker and other lone watchmen must keep the crossroads clear of bandits, prowling predators, and raiding gnolls.

sections.title: Assessing the Gnoll Threat
sections.body: Gnoll camps gathering north and east of Parker’s post draw his attention. As the packs press closer to the road, he sends able-bodied travelers to warn Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire. The Redridge gnolls grow bolder, threatening supply convoys and refugees seeking shelter in town.

sections.title: A Touch of Warmth
sections.body: A lonely roadside post can be grim, yet kindness reaches Three Corners. Darcy, a server at the Lakeshire Inn, sends Parker a warm lunch while he patrols. Touched by her kindness, Parker asks the traveler who brought it to fetch a bouquet from Lakeshire’s herbalist and take it back to Darcy. He asks that the herbalist not be told who the flowers are from or for.

faq.answer: Parker is stationed at Three Corners, where roads meet in southwestern Redridge Mountains near the crossings to Duskwood and Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why is Parker stationed all the way out at Three Corners?
faq.answer: Parker patrols the southern roads from Three Corners and watches the encroaching gnoll packs, helping keep travel and supply routes open to Lakeshire.

faq.q: What threats is Parker monitoring in Redridge?
faq.answer: Parker watches the Redridge gnolls threatening the highway and stays alert to Blackrock orcs at Stonewatch and Shadowhide gnolls near the Tower of Ilgalar.

faq.q: What is Parker's relationship with Darcy?
faq.answer: Darcy works at the Lakeshire Inn and sends Parker a hot lunch at his remote post. In return, Parker asks the traveler who brought it to fetch flowers from the town herbalist for her, as thanks and a sign of his affection.

faq.q: Why doesn't Parker receive reinforcements from Stormwind?
faq.answer: Stormwind sends little help to Redridge while King Varian Wrynn is missing and the capital is caught in political paralysis. Local guards and magistrates must rely on roaming adventurers.

faq.q: What quests does Guard Parker offer?
faq.answer: Parker asks travelers to report the gnoll camps gathering near the road to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire. He also arranges for fresh flowers to be carried to Darcy at the Lakeshire Inn.

angles.text: As an Alliance sentry, Parker shows how a stretched frontier defense struggles to protect its own borders.
As a human, you can see in Parker an ordinary sentry trying to hold the kingdom’s outlying villages together during a national crisis.
As a herbalist, you can find quiet value in the fresh blooms growing across the Redridge hillsides, which Parker seeks for Darcy.
